title: 2-tap mobile generate from staffroom
description: On phones, the Home page renders a single 'Generate for [class] [topic]' tile per recent class. Tap the tile → Generate runs immediately (using the WeekAhead prefetch cache when warm) → renders. Two taps, no form, while waiting for the kettle.
rationale: User's improvement #12 (c). The Web App on mobile currently surfaces the same desktop layout. A staffroom-specific surface that reduces every interaction to one tap dramatically lifts daily-use frequency.
steps: Audit: confirm there's a mobile breakpoint detection helper (`useMediaQuery` or similar). Otherwise add one.
Add MobileTwoTapPanel.tsx: shown only at < 640px; renders up to 4 large tiles (one per top recently-used class as derived from useApp().worksheetHistory + class-auto-brief).

Each tile shows: classLabel, last-used topic (from history), pupil count. Tap → calls aiGenerateWorksheetFromClassBrief on the fly (with prefetch cache from PR-4 if available) and routes via the same weekAheadHandoff pattern.
Mounted in Home.tsx ABOVE WeekAheadPanel on mobile only (and hidden on desktop — the WeekAhead panel already serves desktop).
- client/src/components/__tests__/MobileTwoTapPanel.test.tsx — fixture with 0 / 1 / 4 history entries; mobile vs desktop render boundaries.
do_not_touch: WeekAheadPanel — sibling component, no shared state mutation
acceptance_criteria: On mobile viewport ≤ 640px, Home shows 1–4 large tiles above WeekAheadPanel (which is hidden on mobile to avoid duplication).
Tapping a tile generates within 5s (prefetched) or shows a spinner up to 30s otherwise.
verification: Manual: simulate mobile viewport; tap a tile; confirm worksheet renders.
